nvitk.util.pyhelp_tree
======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.util.pyhelp_tree

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Interactive pyhelp tree: Rich Live display with keyboard expand/collapse.

.. py:data:: _BRANCH_STYLES
   :type:  dict[str, str]

.. py:data:: _TOP_LEVEL_BORDER

.. py:data:: _SECTION_THEME
   :type:  dict[str, dict[str, str]]

.. py:data:: _SUBMODULE_THEME
   :type:  dict[str, dict[str, str]]

.. py:class:: VisibleRow

   One rendered line in the interactive view.


   .. py:attribute:: kind
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: node
      :type:  nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: tool
      :type:  nvitk.cli.catalog.ToolEntry | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: depth
      :type:  int
      :value: 0



   .. py:attribute:: label
      :type:  str
      :value: ''



.. py:function:: flatten_visible(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode]) -> list[VisibleRow]

   Flatten the catalog tree into the ordered list of currently-visible rows (branches, and tools of expanded branches).


.. py:function:: _tool_label(tool: nvitk.cli.catalog.ToolEntry) -> str

   Display label for a tool row: its command name, or its library display label if it has no command.


.. py:function:: _prefix(expanded: bool) -> str

   Rich-markup expand/collapse glyph (``[-]``/``[+]``) for a branch row.


.. py:function:: _indent(depth: int) -> str

   Two-space indent string for tree depth *depth*.


.. py:function:: _branch_style(node: nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode) -> str

   Rich style string for a branch node, from ``_BRANCH_STYLES`` (falls back to bold white).


.. py:function:: _format_branch_row(node: nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode, depth: int) -> str

   Render one catalog branch as a Rich-markup tree row.


.. py:function:: _format_tool_row(tool: nvitk.cli.catalog.ToolEntry, depth: int) -> str

   Render one tool as a Rich-markup row: an installable command (with gpu/mask tags) or a library-only reference.


.. py:function:: _build_table(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode], cursor: int) -> rich.table.Table

   Build the Rich table of visible tree rows, highlighting the row at *cursor*.


.. py:function:: _footer_text(*, interactive: bool = True) -> str

   Rich-markup footer text: keybinding hints, backend flags, and (if interactive) the shell-integration hint.


.. py:function:: _set_all_expanded(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode], expanded: bool) -> None

   Recursively set ``expanded`` on every branch node under *roots*.


.. py:function:: _collapse_all(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode]) -> None

   Collapse every branch, then re-expand the top-level "Image Processing" root as the default view.


.. py:function:: _expand_all(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode]) -> None

   Expand every branch node under *roots*.


.. py:function:: _ui_console() -> rich.console.Console

   Console for the interactive UI (stderr so stdout stays free for command capture).


.. py:class:: _KeyReader

   Single-key reader with arrow-key decoding (Unix).


   .. py:attribute:: _fd


   .. py:attribute:: _old
      :type:  list | None
      :value: None



   .. py:method:: __enter__() -> _KeyReader

      Switch the terminal to cbreak mode (unbuffered single-key reads) if stdin is a TTY.



   .. py:method:: __exit__(*args: object) -> None

      Restore the terminal's original mode.



   .. py:method:: read_key() -> str

      Read and decode one keypress: arrow keys, ENTER, SPACE, ESC, or the raw character.



.. py:function:: _panel_border(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode]) -> str

   Border color for the panel: themed per single top-level root, else a neutral blue for the full tree.


.. py:function:: _render_panel(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode], cursor: int, total_cmds: int, *, interactive: bool, console: rich.console.Console) -> rich.panel.Panel

   Assemble the full Rich panel: header, install count, tree table, and footer hints.


.. py:function:: _default_shell_mode() -> bool

   Use bash readline injection when running under bash interactively.


.. py:function:: run_command_help(command: str, *, console: rich.console.Console | None = None) -> int

   Run ``command --help`` after interactive selection. Returns process exit code.


.. py:function:: _emit_selected_command(command: str, *, shell_mode: bool) -> None

   Write selected command to stdout for shell capture / readline.


.. py:function:: run_interactive_pyhelp(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode], *, total_cmds: int | None = None, shell_mode: bool = False, pick_only: bool = False) -> str | None

   Run interactive TUI. Returns selected command name or None.

   UI renders on /dev/tty (or stderr); selected command is written to stdout.


.. py:function:: _theme_for_root(node_id: str) -> dict[str, str]

   Color theme (border/header/rule) for a top-level catalog root, from ``_SECTION_THEME`` (with a default fallback).


.. py:function:: _theme_for_submodule(node_id: str) -> dict[str, str]

   Color theme (header/cmd/rule) for a submodule section, from ``_SUBMODULE_THEME`` (with a default fallback).


.. py:function:: _format_static_tool_line(tool: nvitk.cli.catalog.ToolEntry, submodule_id: str) -> rich.text.Text

   One compact tool line for the static catalog.


.. py:function:: _render_static_submodule(node: nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode) -> rich.console.Group

   Submodule block: colored header + tool list.


.. py:function:: _render_static_pipeline_tools(tools: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.ToolEntry]) -> rich.console.Group

   Group pipeline commands by cohort for readability.


.. py:function:: _render_static_root_section(node: nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode) -> rich.panel.Panel

   One top-level section (Image Processing, Pipelines, General).


.. py:function:: _static_footer() -> rich.console.Group

   Footer block (backend/device flags + interactive-picker hint) for the non-interactive static catalog print.


.. py:function:: print_static_tree(roots: list[nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode], *, expanded: bool = True, total_cmds: int | None = None, file: TextIO | None = None) -> None

   Print a color-grouped static catalog (``pyhelp --no-interactive``).


.. py:function:: _iter_tools(node: nvitk.cli.catalog.CatalogNode)

   Yield all tools under a catalog node.
